summary_1line: Agastya recounts how arrogant Ravana sought mighty foes, was humiliated on Narayana’s Sweta-dwipa, and reveals Rama as Narayana incarnate destined to slay him.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the white island of Sweta-dwipa, radiant maidens laugh as they toss the furious ten‑headed Ravana between them like a toy.
Ravana’s golden Pushpaka chariot is battered by violent winds above the luminous island in the Milky Ocean.
Narada watches and dances with laughter while Ravana struggles helplessly in the hands of the women of Sweta-dwipa.
